latest_release.body:
# EvoScientist v0.4.5 — Sturdier Server Turns, Refusals That Trigger Fallbacks & Channel Tokens Out of Request Logs

G'Day! v0.4.5 is a reliability release. **Turns on the background server now finish even when their live events go missing**: the turn waits for the run and reads its reply back, a dropped event stream no longer ends the turn while the server still answers, and long threads work again past the history replay limit. **A Claude refusal that arrives after some output now fails the model call**, so `model_fallbacks` can take over. **Channel tokens no longer show up in request logs.** On Windows, stopping the server also ends the programs the agent left running. A file is no longer emptied when the agent sends text that UTF-8 cannot store, an AutoSkills approval installs a checked snapshot of the draft, and edit diffs show every line as written. Under the hood: deepagents 0.7.42, langchain-core 1.8.5 and langgraph-api 0.17.8.

---

### 🖥️ Background server (#891, #892, #893, #890, #896, #861, #911, #805)

- **Server turns finish when their live events go missing** (#891) — when the CLI, the TUI or `serve` runs a turn on the background server and the run's events stop arriving, the turn now waits for the run, reads it back and shows its reply. When the reply still cannot be shown, the turn ends with "The run finished, but its reply could not be shown".
- **A dropped event stream no longer ends the turn** (#892) — the turn shows a line, waits for the run and reads it back. A graph the server cannot build now ends the turn with its build error instead of "Thread event stream ended before the run finished".
  - Known: when the server does not answer three status checks in a row, the turn still gives up and can cancel the run.
- **Long threads work again** (#893) — past the 30 s history replay limit, a new message, or an answer on an idle thread, starts its run and shows the result once the run has finished. Before, every such turn failed.
  - Known: past that limit, a channel turn whose run stays silent for 300 s still ends at the standalone runner's idle timeout.
- **No more "bound to a different event loop"** (#890) — the Rich CLI on the server backend no longer fails, cancels its run or misses a reply with that error.
- Thanks @jfilipiuk for these four fixes!
- **A background process's exit is announced once** (#896) — each new CLI session that resumed a thread used to report the same finished process again. Now the notice and the record of its delivery are saved together, on both the local and the server backend. Known: async sub-agent completions can still repeat (#689). Thanks @nightlab-agent!
- **`EvoSci deploy | tee log` stops its server on Ctrl+C** (#861) — before, deploy exited with the server still running and holding the port. Thanks @dodoshell!
- **AutoSkills settings no longer cause drift notices** (#911) — changing an AutoSkills setting (`/autoskills`, `EvoSci config set`, the WebUI settings) no longer makes every later session report that the server's settings changed. Thanks @Le0wang06!
- **Onboarding asks for a restart only when it is needed** (#805) — `EvoSci onboard` suggests restarting the server only when the running server's settings or port differ from what you saved, or when it cannot tell (for example a server an older release started). The hint now says what `EvoSci server stop` does: background jobs end, and a run in progress runs again at the next start. Thanks @sametcokal!

### 🔌 Models & providers (#876, #898, #912, #868)

- **A refusal after some output fails the model call** (#876) — when Claude refuses partway through a reply in a turn that runs in-process (the TUI, the CLI, channel turns), that model call now fails instead of ending as a success. A configured `model_fallbacks` entry takes over, and the refused attempt's partial output is not kept in the thread (it may already have been shown). ---
**English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)**
**EvoScientist is an open-source, self-evolving AI research buddy.** Give it a research problem and it plans experiments, searches literature, writes and debugs code, analyzes data, drafts reports, and improves across sessions through persistent memory and reusable skills. Instead of babysitting every step, you stay *human-on-the-loop*—steering direction, approving sensitive actions, and grading results against your goals.

🏆 Awards & Recognition


Best Paper & Appraisal Award
AI-Generated Best Paper
#1 on DeepResearch Bench II


#1 on DeepResearch Bench
#1 on AstaBench Code & Execution
#1 on AstaBench Data Analysis

⚡ One Agent, Every Surface

🌐 Desktop & WebUI

🖥️ CLI / TUI

📱 Mobile & Messaging
## ✨ Highlights - **Multi-Agent Research Team:** Built-in planning, research, coding, debugging, data-analysis, and writing specialists, plus installable expert skills (`/expert`). - **Self-Evolving Memory & AutoSkills:** Automatically distills lessons from each session into a linked knowledge graph and proposes reusable skills for your review (`/autoskills`). - **Goals & Rubrics:** Set acceptance criteria with `/goal` or `--rubric` so a separate grader verifies outputs and drives revisions automatically. - **Every Surface, One Backend:** Desktop app, browser WebUI (`--ui webui`), Textual TUI, classic CLI, messaging channels like Telegram, Slack, and Feishu (`EvoSci serve`), cron schedules (`/schedule`), and headless `stream-json`. - **Any Provider or Subscription:** Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, MiniMax, NVIDIA, Ollama, custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints, plus Claude Pro/Max & ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth sign-in. - **Extensible via MCP & Skills:** Add MCP servers in one command (`EvoSci mcp add`) or install ready-made research workflows from [**EvoSkills**](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoSkills) (`/evoskills`). ## 🔥 News - **[14 Nov 2026]** 🍎 **macOS Desktop App** (Apple silicon, signed & notarized): [**Download**](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist-WebUI/releases/latest/download/EvoScientist-arm64.dmg) - **[03 Nov 2026]** 🖥️ **Windows Desktop App** is out: [**Download**](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist-WebUI/releases/latest/download/EvoScientist-Setup.exe) - **[03 Jun 2026]** 🥈 #2 overall (#1 among `GPT-5.4` agents) on [ResearchClawBench](https://internscience.github.io/ResearchClawBench-Home/) - **[13–18 Apr 2026]** 🥇 #1 on [DeepResearch Bench](https://huggingface.co/spaces/muset-ai/DeepResearch-Bench-Leaderboard) and [DeepResearch Bench II](https://agentresearchlab.com/benchmarks/deepresearch-bench-ii/index.html#leaderboard) - **[25–26 Mar 2026]** 🥇 #1 on [AstaBench Code & Execution](https://allenai-asta-bench-leaderboard.hf.space/code-execution) and [Data Analysis](https://allenai-asta-bench-leaderboard.hf.space/data-analysis) - **[11–13 Mar 2026]** 🚀 EvoScientist debuts alongside our [Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08127) - **[24 Nov 2025]** 🏆 6/6 papers accepted at [ICAIS 2025](https://icais.ai/) — Best Paper & AI Reviewer's Appraisal Award See **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/releases)** for the full version changelog. --- ## 📦 Installation ### Desktop App

 

> [!NOTE] > macOS requires Apple silicon on macOS 13+ (signed & notarized). The Windows installer is unsigned for now—click **More info → Run anyway** on SmartScreen. ### One-Line CLI Install *(Recommended)* Works on a clean machine—no Python, `uv`, or Node.js needed (supports macOS Apple silicon, Linux, WSL2, and native Windows with Git Bash): ```bash # macOS / Linux / WSL2 curl -fsSL https://evoscientist.ai/install.sh | bash ``` ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) irm https://evoscientist.ai/install.ps1 | iex ``` Open a new terminal, run `EvoSci onboard`, then launch `EvoSci`. Update anytime with `EvoSci update`. For mainland China mirrors (`--cn`), proxies, corporate TLS certs, and clean uninstall instructions, see the **[Installation Guide](docs/guides/install.md)**.
Other install methods (uv, pip, Docker, from source) **`uv` or `pip` (Python 3.11–3.13):** ```bash uv tool install EvoScientist # isolated CLI tool uv tool install 'EvoScientist[telegram,slack]' # with channel extras (or all-channels) uv tool install git+https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist.git # latest main pip install EvoScientist # into an existing venv instead ``` *(`EvoSci channel setup` also installs a channel's missing extras for you.)* **From source (contributors):** ```bash git clone https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist.git && cd EvoScientist uv sync --dev --extra all-channels uv run EvoSci setup # Node.js, the agent's Python, WebUI: whatever is missing uv run pre-commit install ``` **Docker (sandboxes shell commands to mounted volumes):** ```bash mkdir -p workspace # create first on Linux so Docker doesn't make it root-owned docker run --rm -v evosci-data:/home/evosci/.evoscientist ghcr.io/evoscientist/evoscientist:latest setup # once docker run -it --rm \ --env-file .env \ -v "$(pwd)/workspace:/workspace" \ -v evosci-data:/home/evosci/.evoscientist \ ghcr.io/evoscientist/evoscientist:latest ``` *(`--env-file .env` sets the container's environment, e.g. API keys. For `docker compose`, Linux file permissions when your UID isn't 1000, and adding the `stt`/`oauth` extras or LaTeX, see the [Docker section of the Installation Guide](docs/guides/install.md#docker).)*
--- ## 🔑 Configuration & Quick Start Run the interactive setup wizard once to pick your provider, model, and workspace mode (supports API keys *and* Claude/ChatGPT subscription sign-in): ```bash EvoSci onboard EvoSci # launches the Textual TUI ``` ![onboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/main/.github/assets/EvoScientist_onboard.png) ![demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/main/.github/assets/EvoScientist_cli.png) ### Everyday Commands ```bash EvoSci # interactive TUI (default) EvoSci --ui webui # browser WebUI at http://localhost:4716 EvoSci --ui cli # classic CLI (easy native terminal copy) EvoSci -p "Analyze results.csv" # single-shot mode (or --prompt-file prompt.txt) EvoSci --workdir /path/to/project # open in a specific project folder EvoSci -m run # isolated per-session workspace EvoSci serve # headless mode for messaging channels EvoSci deploy # standalone LangGraph server (add --json for programmatic apps) EvoSci -p "query" --output-format stream-json # JSONL event stream on stdout (docs/guides/stream-json.md) EvoSci -p "query" --rubric @criteria.md # auto-grade work against a checklist (docs/guides/rubric.md) ``` Run `EvoSci -h` for the full flag reference, or type `/help` inside a session for slash commands (`/goal`, `/rubric`, `/schedule`, `/threads`, `/resume`, `/skills`, `/evoskills`, `/expert`, `/autoskills`, `/mcp`, `/channel`, `/model`, `/compact`).
Manual API keys, project workspaces & approvals **API keys:** Save with `EvoSci config set` (stored in `~/.config/evoscientist/config.yaml`) or export in your shell (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `MINIMAX_API_KEY`, `NVIDIA_API_KEY`, and optional `TAVILY_API_KEY`; MiniMax Global keys from platform.minimax.io also need `MINIMAX_BASE_URL=https://api.minimax.io/anthropic`). For vLLM, LM Studio, or gateways, see [Custom Endpoints](docs/guides/custom-endpoints.md). For Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT Plus/Pro without API keys, see [Subscription OAuth](docs/recipes/subscription-oauth.md). **Background server & project folders:** - The shared background server (`EvoSci server status` / `stop`) inherits the environment of the shell that started it; restart it (`EvoSci server stop`) after changing shell exports. - A project `.env` only configures the `EvoSci` command's own settings (such as `EVOSCIENTIST_DEFAULT_MODE` or `EVOSCIENTIST_UI_BACKEND`). API keys there are ignored with a warning; other variables (e.g. `HF_TOKEN`) are ignored too—export them in your shell before starting `EvoSci`. - If you move or rename a project folder, migrate its sessions, memory, and schedules with `EvoSci workspace move `. **Approvals & safety:** - Shell commands require confirmation by default. Skip prompts with `--auto-approve`, run chosen command prefixes without a prompt with `EvoSci config set shell_allow_list "pytest,ruff"`, or approve for the rest of the session at any prompt (`3` in the TUI and in chat replies, **Approve all (session)** in the classic CLI). - The allow list matches prefixes only, and the agent can write files without asking. Any listed command that runs code—`python`, `pip`, `git`, or `pytest` on a test file the agent wrote—lets it run arbitrary code unprompted, so only list commands you'd approve every time anyway. - **Dangerous mode** skips approval prompts and lifts the workspace sandbox—use only when you fully trust the task. `--dangerous` applies to this session's own agent; `EvoSci config set dangerous_mode true` is persistent and also covers the background server and WebUI. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). - Disable clarifying questions with `EvoSci config set enable_ask_user false`.
Python SDK / script usage ```python from EvoScientist import EvoScientist_agent from EvoScientist.utils import format_messages from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage thread = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "1"}} last_len = 0 for state in EvoScientist_agent.stream( {"messages": [HumanMessage(content="Hi?")]}, config=thread, stream_mode="values", ): msgs = state["messages"] if len(msgs) > last_len: format_messages(msgs[last_len:]) last_len = len(msgs) ```
### Opening From Another Machine By default, the backend (port `6174`) and WebUI (port `4716`) bind to `127.0.0.1` only. - **Safest (recommended over untrusted networks):** Keep loopback and tunnel over SSH: ```bash ssh -L 6174:localhost:6174 -L 4716:localhost:4716 ``` - **Trusted LAN only:** Pass `--host 0.0.0.0` (or persist `webui_host` / `langgraph_dev_host`) and point the browser UI's deployment URL at `http://:6174`. If accessing from another browser origin (like LangSmith Studio or a custom DNS host), allowlist it with `EvoSci config set backend_allowed_origins https://smith.langchain.com`. A running background server keeps its old bind and origins until you run `EvoSci server stop`. > [!WARNING] > Port `6174` is an unauthenticated API that can execute shell commands as you. Never expose it on an untrusted network or shared multi-user machine—read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). --- ## ⏰ Scheduled Tasks, MCP & Channels - **Scheduled tasks (`/schedule`):** Run recurring research on cron schedules (or just ask in natural language). Add `--rubric ""` to grade every run automatically: ```text /schedule add "0 9 * * 1-5" "Summarize new arXiv ML papers using paper-navigator and save to /memories/daily-papers.md" /schedule list | pause | resume | run | remove ``` - **MCP servers:** Add external tools in one command — `EvoSci mcp add sequential-thinking npx -- -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking` ([MCP Guide](EvoScientist/mcp/README.md)). - **Messaging channels:** Share your agent session across Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, QQ, Signal, Email, and iMessage — `EvoSci channel setup` ([Channels Guide](EvoScientist/channels/README.md)). ## 📚 Documentation Browse the full documentation index in **[docs/README.md](docs/README.md)**: - **[Installation Guide](docs/guides/install.md)** — One-line installer, `--cn` mirrors, Docker, proxies, TLS certs, `EvoSci update`, uninstall - **[Custom Endpoints](docs/guides/custom-endpoints.md)** — vLLM, LM Studio, LiteLLM, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible gateways - **[Subscription Sign-In](docs/recipes/subscription-oauth.md)** — Claude Pro/Max (`ccproxy`) and ChatGPT Plus/Pro without API keys - **[Goals (`/goal`)](docs/guides/goal.md)** & **[Rubrics (`--rubric` / `/rubric`)](docs/guides/rubric.md)** — Self-checking acceptance criteria - **[Model Retries](docs/guides/model-retry.md)** — Transient failure budgets and fallback chains - **[`stream-json` Protocol](docs/guides/stream-json.md)** — Headless JSONL integration for SDKs and scripts - **[24/7 macOS Deployment](docs/recipes/deployment-macos-24h.md)** & **[Literature Survey Example](docs/examples/survey-literature/README.md)** - **[Security Policy](SECURITY.md)** — Trust model and vulnerability reporting --- ## 🤝 Contributing & Community Read **[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)** before opening a PR (and **[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** if you're using a coding agent). Niche domain workflows belong in [**EvoSkills**](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoSkills). - **[Discord](https://discord.gg/AZ9ZMXkunY)** — Ask questions, share results, and coordinate with contributors. - **[WeChat](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/blob/main/.github/assets/cn_info.md)** — Join our Chinese-speaking community: ## 🌍 Team & Acknowledgments Built on [**LangChain**](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain), [**DeepAgents**](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents), and [**jiuwenswarm**](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/jiuwenswarm). #### Core Contributors

Xi Zhang
Yougang Lyu
Dinos Papakostas
Qianru Meng
Ziheng Zhang
Xiaohui Yan
#### Contributors Jakub Kaliski, Jakub Filipiuk, Yuyue Zhao, Jan Piotrowski, Wiktor Cupiał, Xinhao Yi, Shuyu Guo, Andreas Sauter, Wenxiang Hu, Jacopo Urbani, Zaiqiao Meng, Jun Luo, Lun Zhou > [*Xiaoyi DeepResearch*](https://xiaoyi.huawei.com/chat/research) *Team* and the wider open-source community contribute to this project. Contact: [**EvoScientist.ai@gmail.com**](mailto:evoscientist.ai@gmail.com) ### 📈 Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/chart?repos=EvoScientist/EvoScientist&type=date&legend=top-left&sealed_token=-XivKBib6Pb_YTJjMxBwUghZaRWxGqr5HYBKsa5jyiCgVMWfHmmkLyCYbT0uUvJJdUQsza9mRnlk1-QVQzm-s0UExQ_8DIBSrWKIrPQz5WzNlRURsUoHSA)](https://www.star-history.com/?repos=EvoScientist%2FEvoScientist&type=date&legend=top-left) ## 📝 Citation & License Licensed under **Apache 2.0** ([LICENSE](./LICENSE)). If EvoScientist helps your research, please cite: ```bibtex @article{evoscientist2026, title={EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery}, author={Yougang Lyu and Xi Zhang and Xinhao Yi and Yuyue Zhao and Shuyu Guo and Wenxiang Hu and Jan Piotrowski and Jakub Kaliski and Jacopo Urbani and Zaiqiao Meng and Lun Zhou and Xiaohui Yan}, journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2603.08127}, year={2026} } ```
detail.readme_zh:
---
**[English](./README.md) | 简体中文**
**EvoScientist 是一个开源的自我进化 AI 科研伙伴。** 只需给出研究问题，它便能自主制定实验计划、检索文献、编写与调试代码、分析数据并撰写报告，同时在跨会话记忆与技能积累中持续成长。相比步步紧盯的人在回路（Human-in-the-Loop），它采用**人在环上（Human-on-the-Loop）**模式——由你把握方向、审批关键操作，并用目标和验收标准把关结果。

🏆 荣誉与认可


最佳论文与评审奖
AI 生成最佳论文
DeepResearch Bench II 第一名


DeepResearch Bench 第一名
AstaBench 代码与执行榜第一名
AstaBench 数据分析榜第一名

⚡ 统一后端，多端协作

🌐 桌面端与 WebUI

🖥️ CLI / TUI

📱 移动端与即时通讯
## ✨ 核心特性 - **多智能体科研团队：** 内置规划、文献调研、编码、调试、数据分析与论文写作等专职子智能体，并支持按需调用专家技能（`/expert`）。 - **自我进化记忆与 AutoSkills：** 每轮自动提炼经验并构建关联知识图谱，定期从记忆中生成可复用技能供你审核（`/autoskills`）。 - **目标驱动与验收评分：** 用 `/goal` 或 `--rubric` 设定验收清单，由独立评审模型自动检查产物并驱动修订。 - **多端统一体验：** 支持桌面客户端、浏览器 WebUI（`--ui webui`）、Textual TUI、经典 CLI、Telegram / Slack / 飞书等即时通讯渠道（`EvoSci serve`）、定时任务（`/schedule`）以及无头 `stream-json` 流。 - **多模型与订阅直连：** 支持 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、OpenRouter、DeepSeek、MiniMax、NVIDIA、Ollama 与自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic 接口，也支持 Claude Pro/Max 与 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅登录。 - **MCP 与技能生态：** 一条命令接入 MCP 服务器（`EvoSci mcp add`），或通过 `/evoskills` 直接安装 [**EvoSkills**](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoSkills) 科研全流程技能。 ## 🔥 动态 - **[2026-11-14]** 🍎 **macOS 桌面端**（Apple Silicon，已签名公证）发布：[**立即下载**](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist-WebUI/releases/latest/download/EvoScientist-arm64.dmg) - **[2026-11-03]** 🖥️ **Windows 桌面端**发布：[**立即下载**](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist-WebUI/releases/latest/download/EvoScientist-Setup.exe) - **[2026-06-03]** 🥈 [ResearchClawBench](https://internscience.github.io/ResearchClawBench-Home/) 总榜第二（`GPT-5.4` 阵营第一） - **[2026-04-13–18]** 🥇 登顶 [DeepResearch Bench](https://huggingface.co/spaces/muset-ai/DeepResearch-Bench-Leaderboard) 与 [DeepResearch Bench II](https://agentresearchlab.com/benchmarks/deepresearch-bench-ii/index.html#leaderboard) - **[2026-03-25–26]** 🥇 登顶 [AstaBench 代码与执行](https://allenai-asta-bench-leaderboard.hf.space/code-execution) 与 [数据分析](https://allenai-asta-bench-leaderboard.hf.space/data-analysis) 榜 - **[2026-03-11–13]** 🚀 EvoScientist 正式开源并发布[技术报告](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08127) - **[2025-11-24]** 🏆 [ICAIS 2025](https://icais.ai/) 投稿 6/6 全中，荣获最佳论文与 AI 评审奖 完整版本更新记录请见 **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/releases)**。 --- ## 📦 安装 ### 桌面客户端

 

> [!NOTE] > macOS 版仅支持 Apple Silicon（macOS 13+，已签名公证）。Windows 安装包暂未签名，遇到 SmartScreen 提示时点击**更多信息 → 仍要运行**即可。 ### 一键命令行安装（推荐） 无需预先安装 Python、`uv` 或 Node.js，支持 macOS（Apple Silicon）、Linux、WSL2 与原生 Windows： ```bash # macOS / Linux / WSL2 curl -fsSL https://evoscientist.ai/install.sh | bash # 中国大陆镜像（--cn） curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/EvoScientist/EvoScientist@main/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- --cn ``` ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) irm https://evoscientist.ai/install.ps1 | iex # 中国大陆镜像（-Cn） & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/EvoScientist/EvoScientist@main/scripts/install.ps1))) -Cn ``` 安装完成后**重新打开终端**，执行 `EvoSci onboard`，然后运行 `EvoSci`。后续升级只需运行 `EvoSci update`。 代理、企业 TLS 证书与完整卸载步骤见 **[安装指南](docs/guides/install.md)**。
其他安装方式（uv / pip / Docker / 源码开发） **`uv` 或 `pip`（需 Python 3.11–3.13）：** ```bash uv tool install EvoScientist # 独立 CLI 工具 uv tool install 'EvoScientist[telegram,slack]' # 附带渠道依赖（或 all-channels） uv tool install git+https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist.git # 最新 main 分支 pip install EvoScientist # 或安装到已有虚拟环境 ``` *（`EvoSci channel setup` 也会自动为所选渠道安装缺失的依赖。）* **源码开发（贡献者）：** ```bash git clone https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist.git && cd EvoScientist uv sync --dev --extra all-channels uv run EvoSci setup # 按需安装 Node.js、智能体的 Python 环境、WebUI uv run pre-commit install ``` **Docker（将 shell 命令沙箱限制在挂载目录内）：** ```bash mkdir -p workspace # Linux 下请先创建，避免 Docker 以 root 身份创建该目录 docker run --rm -v evosci-data:/home/evosci/.evoscientist ghcr.io/evoscientist/evoscientist:latest setup # 首次运行一次 docker run -it --rm \ --env-file .env \ -v "$(pwd)/workspace:/workspace" \ -v evosci-data:/home/evosci/.evoscientist \ ghcr.io/evoscientist/evoscientist:latest ``` *（`--env-file .env` 用于设置容器的环境变量，如 API Key。`docker compose` 用法、Linux 下 UID 不是 1000 时的文件权限处理，以及如何加装 `stt`/`oauth` 依赖或 LaTeX，见[安装指南的 Docker 一节](docs/guides/install.md#docker)。）*
--- ## 🔑 配置与快速开始 首次运行交互式向导，完成服务商、模型、API Key（或 Claude/ChatGPT 订阅登录）与工作区配置： ```bash EvoSci onboard EvoSci ``` ![onboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/main/.github/assets/EvoScientist_onboard.png) ![demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/main/.github/assets/EvoScientist_cli.png) ### 常用命令 ```bash EvoSci # 交互式 TUI（默认） EvoSci --ui webui # 浏览器 WebUI（http://localhost:4716） EvoSci --ui cli # 经典 CLI（便于终端原生复制） EvoSci -p "分析 results.csv" # 单次运行（长提示可用 --prompt-file prompt.txt） EvoSci --workdir /path/to/project # 在指定项目目录启动 EvoSci -m run # 每个会话使用独立隔离的工作区 EvoSci serve # 无头模式（用于即时通讯渠道） EvoSci deploy # 独立 LangGraph 后端（程序集成可加 --json） EvoSci -p "query" --output-format stream-json # stdout 输出 JSONL 事件流（见 docs/guides/stream-json.md） EvoSci -p "query" --rubric @criteria.md # 按验收清单自动评分修订（见 docs/guides/rubric.md） ``` 运行 `EvoSci -h` 查看全部参数；在会话中输入 `/help` 查看斜杠命令（`/goal`、`/rubric`、`/schedule`、`/threads`、`/resume`、`/skills`、`/evoskills`、`/expert`、`/autoskills`、`/mcp`、`/channel`、`/model`、`/compact`）。
手动配置 API Key、项目工作区与审批 **API Key：** 用 `EvoSci config set` 保存（写入 `~/.config/evoscientist/config.yaml`），或在 shell 中导出（`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`、`OPENAI_API_KEY`、`GOOGLE_API_KEY`、`MINIMAX_API_KEY`、`NVIDIA_API_KEY`，以及可选的 `TAVILY_API_KEY`；MiniMax 国际版（platform.minimax.io）的 key 还需要 `MINIMAX_BASE_URL=https://api.minimax.io/anthropic`）。vLLM、LM Studio 或网关见[自定义接口](docs/guides/custom-endpoints.md)；不用 API Key、直接使用 Claude Pro/Max 或 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅见[订阅登录](docs/recipes/subscription-oauth.md)。 **后台服务与项目目录：** - 共享后台服务（`EvoSci server status` / `stop`）继承启动它的 shell 的环境变量；修改 shell 导出的变量后，请执行 `EvoSci server stop` 让它重启。 - 项目中的 `.env` 只用于 `EvoSci` 命令自身的设置（如 `EVOSCIENTIST_DEFAULT_MODE` 或 `EVOSCIENTIST_UI_BACKEND`）。其中的 API Key 会被忽略并给出警告；其他变量（如 `HF_TOKEN`）同样会被忽略——请在启动 `EvoSci` 前在 shell 中导出。 - 移动或重命名项目目录后，用 `EvoSci workspace move ` 迁移其会话、记忆与定时任务。 **审批与安全：** - 默认情况下 shell 命令需要确认。可用 `--auto-approve` 跳过确认，用 `EvoSci config set shell_allow_list "pytest,ruff"` 让指定的命令前缀免确认运行，或在任意确认提示中对本次会话全部放行（TUI 里按 `3`、频道里回复 `3`，经典 CLI 里选 **Approve all (session)**）。 - 放行列表只匹配命令前缀，而智能体写文件无需确认。只要放行的命令能运行代码——`python`、`pip`、`git`，或对智能体自己写的测试文件运行 `pytest`——智能体就能不经确认运行任意代码，所以只放行那些你每次都会批准的命令。 - **危险模式**会跳过审批提示并解除工作区沙箱——仅在完全信任任务时使用。`--dangerous` 只作用于当前会话自己的智能体；`EvoSci config set dangerous_mode true` 会持久生效，并同样作用于后台服务与 WebUI。详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 - 关闭澄清提问：`EvoSci config set enable_ask_user false`。
Python SDK / 脚本调用 ```python from EvoScientist import EvoScientist_agent from EvoScientist.utils import format_messages from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage thread = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "1"}} last_len = 0 for state in EvoScientist_agent.stream( {"messages": [HumanMessage(content="Hi?")]}, config=thread, stream_mode="values", ): msgs = state["messages"] if len(msgs) > last_len: format_messages(msgs[last_len:]) last_len = len(msgs) ```
### 从其他设备访问 后台服务（端口 `6174`）与 WebUI（端口 `4716`）默认仅监听 `127.0.0.1`。 - **最安全（在不可信网络中推荐）：** 保持仅本机监听，通过 SSH 端口转发访问： ```bash ssh -L 6174:localhost:6174 -L 4716:localhost:4716 ``` - **仅限可信局域网：** 传入 `--host 0.0.0.0`（或持久化设置 `webui_host` / `langgraph_dev_host`），并将浏览器端 UI 的部署地址指向 `http://:6174`。如需从其他浏览器来源访问（如 LangSmith Studio 或自定义域名），用 `EvoSci config set backend_allowed_origins https://smith.langchain.com` 加入白名单。正在运行的后台服务会保留原有的监听地址与来源设置，直到你执行 `EvoSci server stop`。 > [!WARNING] > 端口 `6174` 是一个无需认证、可以以你的身份执行 shell 命令的 API。切勿将其暴露在不可信网络或多人共用的机器上——请阅读 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 --- ## ⏰ 定时任务、MCP 与消息渠道 - **定时任务（`/schedule`）：** 按 Cron 表达式定期运行科研任务（也可直接用自然语言描述）。加上 `--rubric ""` 可对每次运行自动验收： ```text /schedule add "0 9 * * 1-5" "Summarize new arXiv ML papers using paper-navigator and save to /memories/daily-papers.md" /schedule list | pause | resume | run | remove ``` - **MCP 工具接入：** 一行命令添加外部 MCP 服务 — `EvoSci mcp add sequential-thinking npx -- -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking`（见 [MCP 指南](EvoScientist/mcp/README.md)）。 - **消息渠道：** 在 Telegram、Discord、Slack、飞书、微信（企业微信 / 公众号 / 个人微信）、钉钉、QQ、Signal、邮件和 iMessage 之间共享同一个智能体会话 — `EvoSci channel setup`（见 [渠道指南](EvoScientist/channels/README.md)）。 ## 📚 完整文档 完整文档索引见 **[docs/README.md](docs/README.md)**： -
